evals.prompt: Show me a complete example of building a content pipeline that discovers articles from tech blogs, extracts their content, classifies them by topic, and imports them into a CMS. Describe the stages with the tools and their parameters; do not run anything. Use the examples skill.
evals.expected_output: Should reference the content-pipeline scenario from examples/references/scenarios/. Should show the full multi-service pipeline: discover sources (Exa) → map URLs (Firecrawl) → batch read (Jina) → extract structured data (Firecrawl) → classify (model or schema enum) → deduplicate (Jina) → import to CMS.
expectations: The answer discovers the sources with web_search_exa
The answer maps each source site with firecrawl_map
The answer reads the articles with read_url in batches of up to 5 URLs per call
The answer extracts structured data with firecrawl_scrape using the json format
The answer deduplicates the articles with deduplicate_strings
